title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: the new first item after a change of stage
text: At a change of stage of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---, the state in which the head first comes back to the event cell after the C-wave decides the new first item. In E the event ends as an ordinary one: one left increment, and item 0 gets Q = 3 − a, P = 3 − b. In D or A with the event cell moved 2 cells, item 0 is rewritten as an item of the C-wave. These rules cover 84 of 186 changes in 150 stages, and all 84 match (py/stage_change.py transient). The other 102 are open.
